quotes.author: Guye W., Aventura FL
quotes.text: This was by far the best sport fishing charter I've ever been on. The price was definitely reasonable for the incredible experience. Not only was the crew super friendly, but we caught some serious fish. Everything they instructed us to try, we just caught more and more fish. 4 thumbs up! Definitely coming back again! Would recommend to anyone!

quotes.author: Diana G., Miami Shores, FL
quotes.text: So much FUN!!! We went on the Sport Fishing Trip and caught a Shark!!! We were not able to catch dinner but who cares we caught a SHARK! The boys on board were really awesome with us and made everything even more exciting!! I definitely recommend Fishing Headquarters!
